zh.scopeExplanation: 这四个例子都来自正在监听的范围。代码先检查 SourceScope；未监听的事件会提前过滤。
zh.subscriptionExplanation: Thread 是一个 PR 或聊天话题的事件流。订阅记录决定哪些 Ticket 应当收到上下文。
zh.evalTitle: 没有任务负责，交给评估
zh.evalExplanation: 新请求还没有负责它的 Worker，事件进入 Eval。确定性 gate 先判断资格；Router 再决定任务归属和分派。
zh.requestContext: 允许的用户 · 明确提及 Agent · 新话题
zh.requestResult: 新工作经 Router 分派，再进入独立 Worker。
zh.requestExplanation: Source 把消息转换成 Trigger，带上发送者、时间和所属 Thread。入口先按 ID 去重。
zh.workerExplanation: 接单产生 Ticket 和 Assignment。执行器创建或恢复该 Ticket 的 Session，并在自己的目录中工作。
zh.chatContext: 正在监听的话题 · 无订阅 · gate 配置为忽略
zh.chatResult: 未通过准入的聊天不需要调用模型。
zh.chatExplanation: 能被监听到，不等于值得启动工作。本例把这类未寻址消息的 admission 配置为 ignore。
zh.rejectTitle: 确定性 gate 拒绝候选
zh.rejectExplanation: 没有订阅者负责这条消息，系统尝试 Eval；本例的 gate 不放行，因此不会请求模型研判。
zh.followupMessage: 重试策略改成指数退避。
zh.followupContext: 人的评论 · PR 已绑定活动 Ticket · 有效订阅
zh.followupResult: 已有归属的后续消息直接送给 Worker，无需 Router 再转发。
zh.followupTitle: 同一 PR 出现新意见
zh.followupExplanation: 登录修复的 Worker 已经订阅了这个 PR。这里假设评论属于该任务当前的授权范围。
zh.passTitle: 订阅将评论透传给任务
zh.passExplanation: Intake 将 Trigger 放进已订阅 Ticket 的 Input。Worker 持有任务细节，可以继续原来的工作。
zh.ownedExplanation: 有效的人的后续消息已经有负责者，不进入新的 Eval。输入通过 steer 送入 Worker，Router 仍可收到全局跟进通知。
zh.ciContext: 自动化事件 · PR 已订阅 · 活动 Ticket
zh.ciResult: CI 可扇出给 Worker，同时进入 Eval；不能套用人的后续消息规则。
zh.ciTitle: 测试失败成为一个事件
zh.ciExplanation: CI 通知也是 Trigger，但它不是人的消息。原型对这两种输入有不同的任务归属规则。
zh.ciFanoutTitle: 先把结果送给订阅任务
zh.ciFanoutExplanation: 订阅扇出不要求事件一定来自人。正在处理该 PR 的 Worker 可以收到测试结果。
zh.ciEvalExplanation: 原型会将 bot/CI 事件排入 Eval；gate 仍可能将它忽略。进入评估不代表必定调用模型，更不代表创建新任务。
zh.codeNote: 源码摘录，省略周边实现；教学注释用于说明机制。

zh.lead: 新任务交给 Router；已有任务的后续消息，通过订阅直接到达 Worker。

zh.mapTitle: 事件先经过代码过滤与订阅匹配，再分派或透传给 Worker
zh.mapDescription: Source 产生 Trigger。监听范围过滤后，Thread 检查订阅。有订阅的后续事件送到 Worker，无现有负责者的事件进入 Eval。Eval 的 gate 不通过则忽略，通过后 Router 决定分派。CI 可以同时送给 Worker 并进入 Eval。
zh.active: 粗虚线 + 当前步骤：本步流向
zh.staticTitle: 同一个 Worker，可以收到后续事件
zh.staticExplanation: 订阅将任务和外部话题关联。新任务需要评估和分派；已有归属的人的后续消息可直接送入 Worker。
zh.scrollHint: 左右滑动查看完整路径。

zh.subscriptionLimit: Ticket 的授权范围由 Mandate 记录；收到消息不代表可以扩大工作范围。
zh.evalLimitTitle: 进入 Eval ≠ 调用模型。
zh.evalLimit: 代码 gate 可以提前拒绝；通过后也可能判断无需工作。
zh.ciLimitTitle: 人的 follow-up 与 CI 不同。
zh.ciLimit: CI 可透传给 Worker，同时排入 Eval；本图省略无关的重试和恢复分支。

en.scopeExplanation: All four examples come from a monitored scope. Code checks SourceScope first; events outside it are filtered early.
en.subscriptionExplanation: A Thread is the event stream of a PR or chat topic. Subscriptions identify the Tickets that should receive context.
en.evalExplanation: The new request has no Worker yet. Eval checks admission in code before the Router decides ownership and dispatch.
en.requestContext: Allowed sender · Agent mentioned · New topic
en.requestResult: New work passes through the Router, then runs in an isolated Worker.
en.requestExplanation: The Source creates a Trigger with sender, time, and Thread. Intake first deduplicates its ID.
en.workerExplanation: Accepting work creates a Ticket and Assignment. The executor creates or resumes its Session in a separate directory.
en.chatContext: Monitored topic · No subscriber · Admission set to ignore
en.chatResult: Chat rejected by admission does not need a model call.
en.chatExplanation: Listening to a message does not authorize work. This example sets admission for unaddressed messages to ignore.
en.rejectTitle: The code gate rejects the candidate
en.rejectExplanation: With no subscribed owner, the event reaches Eval. The gate rejects it here, so no model assessment is requested.
en.followupContext: Human comment · PR bound to an active Ticket · Valid subscription
en.followupResult: An owned follow-up reaches the Worker directly, without another Router forwarding call.
en.followupTitle: A new comment on the same PR
en.followupExplanation: The login-fix Worker already subscribes to this PR. We assume the comment stays within the task's mandate.
en.passTitle: The subscription passes the comment through
en.passExplanation: Intake adds the Trigger to the subscribed Ticket's Input. The Worker has the task context and can continue.
en.ownedExplanation: An owned human follow-up skips a new Eval. Input steers the Worker; the Router can still receive a global follow-up notice.
en.ciContext: Automated event · Subscribed PR · Active Ticket
en.ciResult: CI can fan out to the Worker and also enter Eval. Human follow-up ownership rules do not apply.
en.ciTitle: A test failure becomes an event
en.ciExplanation: A CI notice is a Trigger, but not a human message. The prototype applies different ownership rules to these inputs.
en.ciFanoutTitle: Send the result to the subscribed task
en.ciFanoutExplanation: Subscription fan-out is not limited to human events. The Worker on this PR can receive the test result.
en.ciEvalTitle: The same event also enters Eval
en.ciEvalExplanation: The prototype also queues bot/CI events for Eval. The gate may ignore them: evaluation does not guarantee a model call or a new task.
en.codeNote: Source excerpts omit surrounding logic; comments explain the teaching model.
en.pageTitle: Which path does a message take?
en.pageDescription: Compare four events through filtering, Router dispatch, and subscription pass-through, alongside real source code.
en.lead: The Router handles new tasks. Subscriptions deliver owned follow-ups directly to a Worker.
en.simulation: Teaching simulation · Not a recorded run
en.choose: Choose an event and compare its path
en.mapTitle: Code filters and matches subscriptions before dispatch or pass-through to a Worker
en.mapDescription: The Source creates a Trigger. Scope filtering and Thread subscriptions route follow-ups to Workers. Unowned events enter Eval, where a gate may reject them before Router dispatch. CI can reach a Worker and also enter Eval.
en.staticExplanation: Subscriptions connect tasks to external discussions. New tasks need assessment and dispatch; owned human follow-ups reach their Worker directly.
en.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see the full path.
en.fallback: This is a static overview. Enable JavaScript to compare events and replay steps. The explanation and source links below work without JavaScript.
en.limitsTitle: Three limits to keep in mind
en.subscriptionLimit: A Mandate records the Ticket's authority. Receiving a message does not expand it.
en.evalLimitTitle: Eval does not imply a model call.
en.evalLimit: The code gate can reject early. A later assessment can also decide that no work is needed.
en.ciLimit: CI can reach a Worker and also enter Eval. This diagram omits unrelated retry and recovery branches.
en.sourceBoundary: . This illustrates mechanisms, not production capability or real timing. The chat example assumes admission is ignore; other deployments may use different policies.
